question: To what extent should the worship be performed according to the worshipper’s capacity?
premises: Worship may extend up to the lamp offering.
Alternatively, it may extend up to the food offering.
The extent depends on one’s capacity.
inference: The scope of worship is flexible and determined by the worshipper’s capacity.
plain_english: One should worship up to the lamp offering or up to the food offering, according to one’s capacity.
